result:
Test-phase-03 (US2 Track recurring habits) passed: all 18 checks pass, none fail, none are unclear, and no bugs were filed.

**API checks (curl), 9 of 9 pass:**
- Creating a Daily or Weekly habit returns 201 with the habit active and its creation time set.
- Names are checked (rule BR-6): an empty or missing name, or one of 151 characters, returns 400 naming the `name` field; 150 characters is accepted. A bad or missing frequency returns 400.
- Completing with no date records one completion for today in the app's time zone. A future date returns 400.
- Completing the same date again returns 409 (rule BR-7), tried three ways, and there is still only one record.
- Streaks are right. Daily habits give 3, 2 or 0 depending on their completions. A Weekly habit counts the Monday–Sunday week, and its streak goes from 1 to 2 when this week is done.
- Edit saves all three fields.
- A deactivated habit leaves the active list and the dashboard and keeps its history. Completing it returns 409 until it is activated again.
- Undo returns 204 and removes the record.
- A deleted habit and its completions return 404 and appear in no list or dashboard.

**UI checks (Playwright, headless, `/habits`), 9 of 9 pass:**
- The empty state, its Add Habit action and `?add=1` all open the form.
- Creating a Weekly and a Daily habit works, and invalid names show `error-name` with nothing saved.
- The toggle shows "Done today" / "Done this week" with streak 1, and that survives a reload.
- If a habit was already completed through the API, clicking the toggle shows an "already complete" error and still leaves one record.
- Edit opens with the saved values filled in and saves the changes.
- Deactivate shows an "Inactive" badge and disables the toggle; Activate reverses both.
- Delete removes the card and the API returns 404.
- The Habits nav link reaches the page.

The only console errors were the 400, 409 and 404 responses the tests caused on purpose. There were 16 screenshots.

My first name-length attempt used hand-typed names that were 147 and 143 characters, not 151 and 150, so the app accepted both. That was my mistake, not an app bug. I deleted those two habits and re-ran with names generated at the exact lengths; the note is in `curl.log`.

The phase is ticked and set to `done` in `suite.json`, and I added a line to `progress.md`. The report is at `loops/testing/outputs/001-quickflow/suite/test-phase-03-report.md` and the evidence is in `loops/testing/runs/001-quickflow/suite/test-phase-03/attempt-1/`. Next in the suite is test-phase-04 (US3).
